# Sentient Forms Admin App Source

The JavaScript and CSS files in this directory are generated from the SvelteKit admin app source for Sentient Forms 0.3.7.

Public source for this release: https://github.com/TWP-Technologies/sentient-forms-wp-plugin/tree/v0.3.7

Build commands:

```sh
cd admin-app
bun install --frozen-lockfile
bun run build:wp
```
